scripts.build: npm run build -w repropack-cli && npm run build -w repropack-action
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w repropack-cli && npm run build:cli && npm run typecheck -w repropack-action
scripts.test: npm run build:cli && c8 --check-coverage --branches 80 --functions 80 --lines 80 --statements 80 --include "packages/cli/dist/**/*.js" node --test tests/capture.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/report.test.mjs tests/schema.test.mjs tests/skill-contract.test.mjs tests/security/readonly.test.mjs tests/security/redaction.test.mjs
scripts.test:security: npm run build:cli && c8 --check-coverage --branches 90 --functions 90 --lines 90 --statements 90 --include packages/cli/dist/redaction.js node --test tests/security/readonly.test.mjs tests/security/redaction.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:security && npm run build
